# SurgiMD

> SurgiMD is an iPhone app for surgeons and aesthetic clinicians to capture
> standardized before-and-after patient photos. Silhouette capture guides,
> live angle/distance lock, and ghost overlays of previous visits make every
> photo comparable across visits. Patient imagery is encrypted, consent-gated,
> audit-logged, and never touches the camera roll. Built by Infinion Apps
> FZ-LLC in Dubai, UAE.

Key facts:
- Platform: iOS (iPhone). Free tier: up to 15 patients. Pro: unlimited
  patients, clinic cloud sync, ghost-overlay alignment, export-ready collages.
- Specialties: face and neck — oculoplastic (blepharoplasty, ptosis), brow,
  rhinoplasty, facelift, injectables, dermatology.
- Capture system: procedure-specific thin-line silhouette guides, live
  yaw/pitch readouts with level line, distance measurement, ghost overlay of
  prior visit, fixed 1:1 framing for honest comparisons.
- Security: end-to-end encryption (device, transit, cloud), EXIF/GPS/device
  metadata stripped from every photo, Face ID app lock, per-clinic server-side
  isolation, tamper-evident hash-chained audit log, versioned per-patient
  consent capture; sharing/printing/export are consent-gated.
- Compliance posture: designed to support GDPR (clinic = controller,
  SurgiMD = processor; DPA available), HIPAA (HIPAA-eligible infrastructure,
  technical safeguards, BAAs available), and DHA/UAE health data law
  (Federal Law No. 2 of 2019); local-only on-device mode for strict data
  residency. There is no official "HIPAA certification" — SurgiMD says
  "designed to support" deliberately.
- Data ownership: the clinic owns patient data; export anytime; deleting a
  patient removes data from device and cloud; on cancellation data remains
  exportable and the app returns to the free tier.
